node.title: Re^2: rename file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If this is all happening on the same file system, then it's an atomic rename (fully done or not at all).

It's not quite that simple. While [man://rename;2|rename(2)] is supposed to be atomic on POSIXish systems, there are several of corner cases where that isn't completely reliable (e.g. NFS). One really has to know what OS and filesystem one is working on.
